d: Short, wavy ash-grey hair peeks from under a white fluffy ushanka, framing a youthful, child-like face with large, wide-set grey eyes. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a navy blue suit paired with a long olive-green parka lined with thick white faux fur and a patterned dark scarf. A dark blue satchel hangs at the side, and a small blue gemstone is held in the hand alongside a large, vibrant yellow sunflower.
